lyrics:
[Intro: crisp disco drums, rubbery bass line]

[Riff: bright bouncing bell-like synth]
(Hey)

[Section A: riff and bass together, handclaps]
(Hey, hey)

[Section B: string stabs, cowbell, riff answers]

[Break: bass alone, lobby murmur, a desk bell, a purr]

[Spoken: a doorman, dry]
Evening, sir

[Riff Returns: full groove, riff doubled an octave up]
(Hey, hey)

[Outro: drums and bass, the riff fading, one small meow]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 120 BPM, 4/4, A minor with a bright, major-sounding riff. Bouncy, stylish and good-humoured.

VOICE: No sung vocals. Short one-syllable vocal stabs used as percussion. A doorman speaks two dry words to the cat in the break.

INSTRUMENTS: A bright, bell-like synth playing a bouncing riff, a rubbery synth bass, crisp disco drums with open hi-hats, handclaps, cowbell, short string stabs, a lobby murmur, a desk bell, a cat's purr and one meow.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, drums and bass. 0:16 Riff. 0:48 Section A. 1:20 Section B, strings. 1:50 Break, bass alone. 2:02 Spoken line. 2:06 Riff returns, doubled. 2:50 Outro, one meow at 3:14.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2010 nu-disco: clean, bright and punchy, bass rubbery and forward, drums crisp.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The doorman's 'Evening, sir' at 2:02 and the riff coming back doubled.

STATION FIT: Saturday, 7:30 p.m. A bright instrumental for getting dressed and coming downstairs.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Poised, strutting, amused, gone.
